The only way to infer it is by measuring the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample at hand, which should be available. By examining the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm) we can count the distinct aromatic carbon signals, which correspond to the number of aromatic carbons (considering symmetry). We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum and then count the aromatic peaks.</thought>
